requirements.title: The account sits behind an AccountClient interface whose in-memory fake starts at $250.00, holds 8 contacts and has a send that can be made to fail
Typing in the contact search filters the contact list by name
Tapping a contact opens the amount screen for that contact
The keypad enters dollars with digits, 1 decimal point and delete, rejecting a third decimal digit, a second decimal point and leading zeros ("007" shows as "7")
The amount shows formatted as currency while the user types
Continue is enabled only for an amount above $0.00 and no more than the balance
Money is held as Decimal, never a floating-point type, so $0.10 + $0.20 debits exactly $0.30
The confirmation screen shows the contact and the amount, and Send calls the client
A successful send lowers the balance by the amount and puts the payment at the top of the first screen's activity list
A failed send leaves the balance unchanged and shows an error with a way to try again
The existing APIClient and LogClient tests keep passing
